notes:
Summary: Avalora is a mid-market KM/SaaS vendor building a federated search + recommendations product for enterprise customers. They started on Hosted API to move fast but are actively evaluating Dedicated for predictable throughput and VPC requirements. Primary interest: reranking endpoint to combine BM25/embedding candidate generation with a learned reranker for improved NDCG on narrow domain queries.

Recent timeline / activity (bullets):
- 2026-01-12: Intro demo with AE + SE; walked through Hosted API latency and streaming. (ff_20260112_avalora_demo)
- 2026-01-28: Sent POC data spec and sample eval set (10k queries, click labels, doc IDs).
- 2026-02-08: SE deep-dive: offline scoring pipeline, mapping their features -> Redwood rerank endpoint input. Recorded session (ff_20260208_avalora_poc_review).
- 2026-02-22: First hosted baseline run: BM25 + embeddings candidate generation; ran Redwood hosted reranker end-to-end on sample eval. Observed NDCG uplift but p95 latency ~210ms for 3-stage pipeline.
- 2026-03-01: Pricing call to discuss 12-month Dedicated commit vs pay-as-you-go hosted. AE shared draft pricing (drive link).

Use-case & technical requirements (shorthand):
- Workload: user-facing search with rerank per query; average 8 candidates; bursty QPS (10-40 qps peak across regions).
- Targets: p95 latency <= 150ms for reranker only; end-to-end service latency target <= 300ms; throughput target ~25 qps sustained with headroom.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget; willing to commit if cost/save analysis shows 25-40% token-cost reduction with Dedicated + batching/caching.
- Model preference: quantized 7B-13B family (customer prefers open-weight models); fallback to smaller 3-7B variants for burst control.
- Routing/fallback: need auto-fallback to cheaper variant + regional routing to EU/NA; plan to use Redwood routing policies.
- Eval metrics: NDCG@10, MRR, Precision@5; offline scoring to run nightly with historical logs.
- Integration: offline scorer must accept CSV of candidates + features; will run batch scoring and store reranker scores in their ranking DB.

Security/compliance notes:
- Requires SSO/SAML for console; must demonstrate audit_logging and KMS integration for keys.
- Data residency: EU customer subset requires EU region hosting for that tenant.

POC plan & milestones: (approx)
- Stage 1: Baseline run on Hosted API with their eval set (complete). Metrics and logs collected.
- Stage 2: Hosted reranker tuning: iterate prompts/configs + scoring thresholds (in progress).
- Stage 3: Dedicated trial: spin up small Dedicated pool in NA + EU, replicate tests for latency and cost (planned).
- Stage 4: Integration test: offline scoring pipeline + nightly batch scoring into their DB; validate APP-level metrics.

Open questions / blockers (notes):
- Procurement timeline: legal needs proof of EU data residency and SOC2 artefacts; procurement may take 6-8 weeks.
- Benchmark variance: SE noted some long-tail queries show unstable NDCG improvements; requires more eval examples and quality error analysis.
- Pricing: need committed throughput bands for Dedicated proposal; customer wants a model for credits consumption under bursty loads.

Quotes & customer language (paraphrase):
- "We need reranking that actually moves NDCG on product taxonomy queries — not just pretty embeddings."
- "If Dedicated can give consistent 150ms p95 and predictable monthly cost, we'll prefer committing."

Action items for Redwood team:
- SE to push a tuned reranker configuration (config id in Drive) and share offline scoring example payloads.
- AE to provide Dedicated pricing tiers with burst allowance + EU residency option.
- Ask: provide example compliance package (SOC2 + KMS integration guide) for procurement.
